node.text:
Hoy! Welcome to' the galley, mate! Me name be Chymero! The chief chef o' dis place.
I hear ye've done a lot t' help us! I be grateful, The loss o' our kin has saddened us, put a hole in our hearts. We've strived t' show kindness 'n warmth t' others, no matter the look or shape.
Now look where it got us? Strugglin'.
But forget all dat, aye? Ye've done much fer us, friend. 'Ere, 'ave a look at our stock if ye ever got a hankerin' fer somethin'.
node.choice: I desire nothing. Live and drink.
